title: 第29集 第17章 世界最强的生命第29集 第16章 方天师
lines: 一座乡下野林子，周围数里范围布置有重重驱魔大阵，更建造了一座占地数里的土城，天下各大派更有驱魔弟子长期驻守于此，还有士兵们辅助镇守，士兵们主要是防止普通人靠近。
“九大源魔之一的‘舌狱魔’。”布衣布鞋的断臂男子，拎着一箱子来到了这座土城的城门口。
城门口早有大量士兵们举起枪指向孟川：“赶紧走。”
“不得靠近。”
这些士兵们都呵斥道。
九大源魔的镇守之地，负责镇守的士兵，大多是代代相传！有的都传承上千年，是可以用命来镇守封禁之地的。
孟川放下箱子，从怀中取出一块深紫色令牌。
“天师令？”这些士兵们吃惊地面面相觑，立即有士兵往土城内跑去，仅仅片刻，一位背着雨伞的消瘦男子走了出来，他一看到孟川，便立即行礼：“清天宗柳曲，拜见方天师！”
孟川点点头。
这些年和各方驱魔势力交流经验，实力得到公认，天下驱魔联盟也给孟川发放了天师令！孟川也成为这驱魔联盟一份子。
驱魔联盟成立，就是为了更好的联手，应对源魔这一威胁！
“我想要进去，试着对付舌狱魔。”孟川说道。
“对付舌狱魔？”柳曲惊愕万分，“方天师，万万不可，源魔不死不灭，只可封禁，没法斩杀。”
“我想试试。”孟川说道，“放心，我不会碰封禁大阵分毫，会单独进入封禁大阵内部。”
柳曲暗松一口气，封禁大阵是代代驱魔高人不断加固的，不管是何身份，都不容许破坏！孟川只要不破坏封禁大阵，那一切都好说。
“方天师，你进入封禁大阵内，就会碰到那头源魔。到时候我们在阵外没法帮你。”柳曲担心道。
“不用。”孟川摇头。
“这实在太危险了。”柳曲还是很钦佩方天师的，毕竟年仅二十九岁的方天师，绝对是整个驱魔界的传说。
“我持天师令，可以进去吧。”孟川看着他，天师已是驱魔联盟最高层。
柳曲恭敬道：“方天师硬是要进去，我们自然无法阻拦。只是望方天师，务必小心。”
孟川点头，收起令牌，又拎着箱子往里走。
这座土城很快骚动起来了。
“什么？方天师要孤身进封禁大阵内，要试着对付源魔？”
“这太危险了。”
“即便是天下第一的驱魔天师，进去都可能丧命啊。”
“天师何等实力，既然敢进去，至少有逃出来的把握吧。”镇守之地的士兵们、驱魔人、驱魔师平常生活也很枯燥，如今都议论纷纷，他们没有一个会认为源魔会死！实在是数千年来，九大源魔就从来没死过。即便某个时代有超过十名驱魔天师，大群驱魔师一同配合布阵联手，也从未杀死过。
漫长岁月，代代镇守于此，他们潜意识都认为源魔是不死的。
孟川拎着箱子，孤身走进封禁大阵内，看到了眼前的这座野树林。
一眼能看出，野树林中央，曾有一座占地颇大的府邸，只是漫长岁月，只残留些许府邸的根基，连完好的瓦片都难寻了，而且那野树长得非常好，毕竟很久没生灵进来了。
走到这荒废府邸的根基前，孟川放下箱子在脚边。
“竟然有驱魔人敢进来。”低沉雄浑的声音从地底传出。
“听说九大源魔很厉害。”孟川说道，“我很好奇，天下间是否有比你们更强的存在？”
“至少我活到如今七千年，也破封而出数次，还真没听说有比源魔更强的存在。难道你这小小驱魔人，知道有比源魔更强大的？”那雄浑声音饶有兴趣说道，它也寂寞太久了，难得有个不怕死的进来，自然多聊聊。
“七千年，没听说比源魔更强的？”孟川微微点头，“我觉得，我应该比你强。”
说着，孟川左手一挥，一道符令飞出，悬浮当空。
“哈哈哈，真是狂妄。”
残留的府邸根基处却有血雾升腾，血雾中更出现了一条条长长舌头，密密麻麻舌头，每一条舌头都迅速暴涨数十丈，席卷向孟川。
“雷法，灭！”孟川单手结印，引动高空的雷法符令。
content_en:
In a wild forest in the countryside, there are numerous exorcism formations arranged within several miles around, and an earthen city covering an area of ​​several miles has been built. Exorcism disciples from all major sects in the world are stationed here for a long time, and there are also soldiers to assist in guarding. The soldiers mainly prevent ordinary people from approaching.
"The 'Tongue Hell Demon', one of the nine source demons." A man with a broken arm in cloth clothes and shoes came to the gate of this earth city carrying a box.
There were already a large number of soldiers at the city gate raising their guns and pointing at Meng Chuan: "Hurry and leave."
"Don't come near."
The soldiers scolded.
The place guarded by the nine great source demons, most of the soldiers responsible for guarding it have been passed down from generation to generation! Some of them have been passed down for thousands of years and can be used to guard forbidden places.
Meng Chuan put down the box and took out a dark purple token from his arms.
"Order of the Heavenly Master?" These soldiers looked at each other in surprise, and some soldiers immediately ran into the Tucheng. Within a moment, a thin man carrying an umbrella came out. As soon as he saw Meng Chuan, he immediately saluted: "Liu Qu, Qing Tianzong, pays homage to Fang Tianshi!"
Meng Chuan nodded.
Over the years, we have exchanged experiences with various exorcism forces, and our strength has been recognized. The World Exorcism Alliance also issued the Order of Heavenly Master to Meng Chuan! Meng Chuan also became a member of this exorcism alliance.
The Exorcist Alliance was established to better join forces to deal with the threat of the source demon!
"I want to go in and try to deal with the Tongue Hell Demon." Meng Chuan said.
"Deal with the Tongue Hell Demon?" Liu Qu was extremely shocked, "Master Fang, you must not do it. The Origin Demon is immortal, so you can only ban it, but you can't kill it."
"I want to give it a try." Meng Chuan said, "Don't worry, I won't touch the banning formation at all. I will enter the banning formation alone."
Liu Qu secretly breathed a sigh of relief. The sealing formation has been continuously strengthened by generations of exorcism masters. No matter who they are, they are not allowed to be destroyed! As long as Meng Chuan doesn't destroy the banning formation, everything will be fine.
"Master Fang, if you enter the forbidden formation, you will encounter the source demon. We will not be able to help you outside the formation then." Liu Qu said worriedly.
"No need." Meng Chuan shook his head.
"This is really too dangerous." Liu Qu still admired Fang Tianshi. After all, Fang Tianshi, who was only 29 years old, was definitely a legend in the entire exorcism world.
"I hold the Celestial Master's order, so you can go in." Meng Chuan looked at him. The Celestial Master was already the highest level of the Exorcism Alliance.
Liu Qu said respectfully: "Fang Tianshi insists on going in, so of course we can't stop him. Just look at Fang Tianshi and be careful."
Meng Chuan nodded, put away the token, and carried the box inside again.
The earthen city soon became commotion.
"What? Master Fang wants to enter the forbidden formation alone and try to deal with the source demon?"
"This is too dangerous."
"Even the best exorcist in the world may die if he goes in."
"How powerful the Celestial Master is. If you dare to go in, you can at least be sure of escaping." The soldiers, exorcists, and exorcists guarding the place also have a boring daily life. Now they are all talking about it. None of them think that the source demon will die! In fact, for thousands of years, the nine source demons have never died. Even if there were more than ten exorcist masters in a certain era, and a large group of exorcists formed a coordinated formation, they had never killed anyone.
For a long time, they have guarded here for generations, and they subconsciously believe that the source demon is immortal.
"Huh."
Meng Chuan carried the box and walked into the forbidden formation alone, and saw the wild forest in front of him.
It can be seen at a glance that there used to be a large mansion in the middle of the wild forest. However, over the years, only some of the foundations of the mansion remain. Even the intact tiles are hard to find. Moreover, the wild trees are growing very well. After all, no living creatures have come in for a long time.
Walking to the foundation of the abandoned mansion, Meng Chuan put down the box at his feet.
"An exorcist dares to come in." A deep and powerful voice came from the ground.
"I heard that the nine source demons are very powerful." Meng Chuan said, "I am very curious, is there anything stronger than you in the world?"
"At least I have lived for seven thousand years and have broken out of the seal several times. I have never heard of an existence stronger than the Origin Demon. Do you, a little exorcist, know that there is someone more powerful than the Origin Demon?" The majestic voice said with interest. It has been lonely for too long. It is rare for someone who is not afraid of death to come in, so naturally we can chat more.
"In seven thousand years, have you never heard of anyone stronger than the Origin Demon?" Meng Chuan nodded slightly, "I think I should be stronger than you."
With that said, Meng Chuan waved his left hand, and a talisman flew out and floated in the air.
"Hahaha, how arrogant."
There was blood mist rising from the foundation of the remaining mansion, and long tongues appeared in the blood mist, densely packed with tongues. Each tongue quickly rose dozens of feet and swept towards Meng Chuan.
"Thunder spell, destroy it!" Meng Chuan formed a seal with one hand, triggering the thunder spell from high in the sky.
